facts.text: Melanie mentioned that the best part of going to the beach with her kids was seeing their happy faces.

evidence.quote: Seeing my kids' faces so happy at the beach was the best!

facts.text: Melanie stated that they do not go to the beach often, usually only once or twice a year.

evidence.quote: We don't go often, usually only once or twice a year.

facts.text: Melanie described their family camping trip as a summer tradition where they roast marshmallows, tell stories around the campfire, and enjoy each other's company.

evidence.quote: We always look forward to our family camping trip. We roast marshmallows, tell stories around the campfire and just enjoy each other's company.

facts.text: Melanie recalled a camping trip where they saw the Perseid meteor shower and made wishes, which she described as a memory she will never forget.

evidence.quote: I'll always remember our camping trip last year when we saw the Perseid meteor shower. It was so amazing lying there and watching the sky light up with streaks of light. We all made wishes and felt so at one with the universe. That's a memory I'll never forget.
